title: Nongenetic Factors Associated With Onset and Severity of Hereditary Ataxia
journal: Neurology · Casey HL, Springall De Pablo M, Boyle TA, Hogan MB, Lauderdale DS, Gomez CM（芝加哥大學神經科與公共衛生學系，美國；共同作者含南佛羅里達大學、SCA6 Network、Solaxa, Inc.、SCA27b Ataxia Foundation）· doi:10.1212/WNL.0000000000218378
tag: SCA6／SCA27B 病程修飾因子
note: → 問卷世代研究，SCA6 282 人、SCA27B 127 人，以迴歸模型找發病年齡與嚴重度的相關因子。結果分成兩半：SCA6 由基因主導——女性、非白人族裔、CAG 重複越長者發病越早；SCA27B 則與環境暴露的關聯較強——農藥接觸與病毒感染和發病時點／嚴重度相關。⚠️ 自陳問卷、橫斷面、相關性研究，不能推論因果，且 SCA27B（FGF14 GAA 重複）近年才被辨識、族群樣本仍小。記錄價值：(1) 若非基因因子真的能解釋 SCA27B 相當比例的發病時點變異，該亞型的試驗設計必須把這些暴露納入分層或校正，否則會被當成雜訊吃掉檢定力；(2) 作者群列有 Solaxa（正在開發 SCA27B 適應症的競品）的隸屬，顯示該公司已在建立自己的疾病自然史／病人分群基礎——這是進臨床前的常見鋪路動作，值得追蹤。

en.journal: Neurology · Casey HL, Springall De Pablo M, Boyle TA, Hogan MB, Lauderdale DS, Gomez CM (Department of Neurology and Department of Public Health Sciences, University of Chicago, USA; co-authors from University of South Florida, SCA6 Network, Solaxa, Inc. and the SCA27b Ataxia Foundation) · doi:10.1212/WNL.0000000000218378
en.note: → A survey-based cohort study of 282 people with SCA6 and 127 with SCA27B, using regression models to identify factors correlated with age at onset and severity. The findings split in two: SCA6 onset is driven mainly by genetics — female sex, non-White race and longer CAG repeats were associated with earlier onset — whereas SCA27B shows stronger associations with environmental exposures, with pesticide contact and viral infection linked to timing and severity. ⚠️ Self-reported, cross-sectional and correlational — it cannot establish causation, and SCA27B (an FGF14 GAA repeat disorder) was only recently recognised, so cohorts remain small. Why it is recorded: (1) if non-genetic factors really do explain a meaningful share of the variation in SCA27B onset, trials in this subtype will need to stratify or adjust for those exposures or lose power to the added noise; (2) the author list includes an affiliation with Solaxa, a competitor developing for SCA27B, indicating the company is building its own natural-history and patient-stratification base — a common groundwork step ahead of the clinic, and worth tracking.

title: Expanded ATXN10 Alleles in Neurodegenerative Disorders: A Case Series and Review of the Literature
journal: Movement Disorders Clinical Practice · Cornejo-Olivas M, Raney A, Abad A 等，通訊作者 Schüle B（祕魯 Universidad Científica del Sur 與 Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Neurológicas；共同作者含史丹佛大學病理學系與 Pacific Biosciences，美國）· doi:10.1002/mdc3.70765
tag: SCA10 診斷 · 重複擴增判讀
note: → 三名依 RP-PCR 篩檢結果「疑似 SCA10」的病人，改用長讀定序後三人實際上都是別的神經退化疾病。作者主張 ATXN10 的 100–150 中間長度等位基因未必致病，並在文獻回顧中找到更多「ATXN10 擴增與其他遺傳性共濟失調並存」的案例，結論是只靠 RP-PCR 不足以定診，需要更完整的基因檢測。⚠️ 僅三例個案序列＋文獻回顧，樣本極小，不足以改寫診斷閾值。 記錄價值：SCA 亞型的收案分型準確度直接決定試驗品質——若中間長度等位基因被誤判成致病，收進來的受試者其實根本不是該亞型，會同時稀釋療效訊號並污染自然史對照組。這對採用外部自然史對照的設計特別致命（見試驗雷達 NCT06529146）。對本社而言，這是收案基因判讀 SOP 的一則提醒，不是競品動態。

en.journal: Movement Disorders Clinical Practice · Cornejo-Olivas M, Raney A, Abad A et al., corresponding author Schüle B (Universidad Científica del Sur and Instituto Nacional de Ciencias Neurológicas, Lima, Peru; co-authors from Stanford University School of Medicine and Pacific Biosciences, USA) · doi:10.1002/mdc3.70765
en.note: → Three patients flagged as suspected SCA10 on RP-PCR screening were re-analysed with long-read sequencing, and all three turned out to have different neurodegenerative conditions. The authors argue that intermediate ATXN10 alleles in the 100–150 range may not be pathogenic, and their literature review surfaced further cases where an expanded ATXN10 allele coexisted with a different genetic ataxia — concluding that RP-PCR alone is not sufficient for diagnosis. ⚠️ Three cases plus a review: far too small to redraw any diagnostic threshold. Why it is recorded: accuracy of subtype assignment at enrolment directly determines trial quality — if intermediate alleles are misread as pathogenic, enrolled participants may not have the subtype under study at all, simultaneously diluting the efficacy signal and contaminating the natural-history control. That is especially damaging for designs that rely on an external natural-history control (see NCT06529146 in the trial radar). For us this is a reminder about genetic-screening SOP at enrolment, not a competitor development.

title: Domain-dependent uncoupling of the co-chaperone and E3 ubiquitin ligase CHIP underlies heterogeneity in spinocerebellar ataxia 48
journal: Journal of Biological Chemistry · Altinok S, Paulakonis E, Almeida MF 等，通訊作者 Schisler JC（北卡羅來納大學教堂山分校 McAllister 心臟研究所與藥理學系，美國；共同作者含邁阿密大學、鄭州大學、約翰霍普金斯、杜克大學）· doi:10.1016/j.jbc.2026.113399
tag: SCA48 · CHIP／STUB1 機轉
note: → SCA48 由 STUB1 基因的異型合子突變造成，其產物 CHIP 身兼共伴護蛋白與 E3 泛素連接酶兩種功能。本研究逐一比較落在不同蛋白domain 的變異，發現它們的生化後果並不一致——有些保有連接酶活性但結合能力下降，有些則完全喪失功能；作者認為這種「依 domain 而異的雙功能解偶聯」正是 SCA48 病人臨床表現差異極大的來源。⚠️ 生化與細胞層級研究，無動物或人體療效資料。 記錄價值：SCA48 是罕見的體染色體顯性亞型，目前沒有任何公司在推進其臨床開發，因此這則不構成競品動態；收錄的理由是它示範了一個對整個 polyQ／共濟失調領域都成立的觀念——同一基因的不同變異可能需要方向相反的介入，這會直接影響未來任何針對 STUB1 的療法要如何分群收案。

en.journal: Journal of Biological Chemistry · Altinok S, Paulakonis E, Almeida MF et al., corresponding author Schisler JC (McAllister Heart Institute and Department of Pharmacology, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, USA; co-authors from Miami University, Zhengzhou University, Johns Hopkins and Duke) · doi:10.1016/j.jbc.2026.113399
en.note: → SCA48 is caused by heterozygous mutations in STUB1, whose product CHIP acts both as a co-chaperone and as an E3 ubiquitin ligase. Comparing variants across different protein domains, the authors found the biochemical consequences differ: some variants retained ligase activity but bound poorly, others abolished function outright. They attribute the wide clinical heterogeneity of SCA48 to this domain-dependent uncoupling of CHIP's two functions. ⚠️ Biochemical and cell-level work; no animal or human efficacy data. Why it is recorded: SCA48 is a rare dominant subtype with no company currently pursuing clinical development, so this is not a competitor movement. It earns a place because it illustrates a principle that generalises across the polyglutamine and ataxia field — different variants in the same gene may require interventions pointing in opposite directions, which bears directly on how any future STUB1-directed therapy would have to stratify enrolment.

title: Downbeat Nystagmus and Saccadic Oscillations in Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 27B: A 14-Month Follow-Up Case Report
journal: Case Reports in Neurology · Skacik P, Koprusakova MT, Sivak S, Grofik M, Kurca E（斯洛伐克 Martin 大學醫院 Jessenius 醫學院神經科）· doi:10.1159/000552966
tag: SCA27B · 眼動終點
note: → 單一 SCA27B 病人追蹤 14 個月的眼動變化。作者指出下跳性眼震（downbeat nystagmus）早期可能只在誘發姿勢下出現，之後才變成自發性；病人接受 4-aminopyridine 後臨床上有改善，但客觀眼動量測幾乎沒變。⚠️ 單一病例報告，證據等級最低，不能推論療效。 記錄價值在那個落差本身：SCA27B 圈層（Solaxa 的目標適應症、IntraBio 的 EA2／SCA6 圈層也相鄰）若要用眼動當客觀終點，這則觀察提示眼動量測與病人主觀感受可能不同步——終點選擇上是個要留意的訊號，不是結論。

en.journal: Case Reports in Neurology · Skacik P, Koprusakova MT, Sivak S, Grofik M, Kurca E (Neurology Department, Jessenius Faculty of Medicine, University Hospital Martin, Slovakia) · doi:10.1159/000552966
en.note: → Fourteen months of oculomotor follow-up in a single SCA27B patient. The authors note that downbeat nystagmus may at first be detectable only under provocative conditions before becoming spontaneous, and that although the patient improved clinically on 4-aminopyridine, objective eye-movement measurements barely changed. ⚠️ A single case report — the lowest tier of evidence, and no efficacy can be inferred. The value lies in that mismatch: for the SCA27B ring (Solaxa's target indication, adjacent to IntraBio's EA2 / SCA6 ring), it flags that objective oculomotor measures and patient-perceived benefit may not move together — a signal to weigh in endpoint selection, not a conclusion.

title: Expanded ATXN3 CAG Repeat is Stable in Human Purkinje Cells
journal: Movement Disorders · Chetia H, Kus L, Sipos E, Heintz N, Mätlik K（洛克斐勒大學分子生物學實驗室，美國；通訊作者現於塔林理工大學，愛沙尼亞）· doi:10.1002/mds.70465
tag: SCA3 體細胞重複不穩定性
note: → 作者以人類死後腦組織的細胞類型特異性分析，檢驗 SCA3 病人普金氏細胞（Purkinje cell）內突變 ATXN3 的 CAG 重複是否會隨年齡持續擴增。結論是擴增幅度極小，與小腦顆粒細胞相當，且比紋狀體神經元穩定；作者因此認為體細胞重複擴增不足以解釋 SCA3 普金氏細胞的選擇性退化。⚠️ 本則為死後人腦組織的分子定量，摘要未載明樣本數，且未做療效或介入評估。 記錄價值：亨丁頓舞蹈症近年最熱的一條藥理路線是抑制體細胞重複擴增（如鎖定 MSH3 的錯配修復調控），並被視為可橫向移植到其他 polyQ 疾病。若此結果在更大樣本重現，代表該路線在 SCA3 的理論基礎較弱，相對之下「直接降低突變蛋白」的路線（Vico VO659 這類 CAG 標的 ASO、Biogen 已放棄的 BIIB132）在 SCA3 的機轉正當性反而更穩固。單篇論文不足以定論，列為觀察指標。

en.journal: Movement Disorders · Chetia H, Kus L, Sipos E, Heintz N, Mätlik K (Laboratory of Molecular Biology, The Rockefeller University, USA; corresponding author now at Tallinn University of Technology, Estonia) · doi:10.1002/mds.70465
en.note: → Using cell-type-specific analysis of human post-mortem brain, the authors asked whether the mutant ATXN3 CAG repeat keeps expanding inside the Purkinje cells of people with SCA3. They report that the expansion is minimal — comparable to cerebellar granule neurons and more stable than in striatal neurons — and conclude that somatic repeat expansion does not account for the selective degeneration of Purkinje cells in SCA3. ⚠️ This is molecular quantification in post-mortem human tissue; the abstract does not state the sample size, and no intervention or efficacy was assessed. Why it is recorded: one of the hottest pharmacological routes in Huntington's disease is suppressing somatic repeat expansion (for example modulating mismatch repair via MSH3), and it is widely assumed to transfer to the other polyglutamine diseases. If this result replicates in larger samples, it implies the rationale for that route is weaker in SCA3, and conversely that lowering the mutant protein directly — CAG-directed ASOs such as Vico's VO659, or Biogen's discontinued BIIB132 — rests on firmer mechanistic ground in SCA3. A single paper is not decisive; logged as an indicator to watch.

title: BRD4 recruitment into HP1 condensates desilences transcription without erasure of repressive chromatin
journal: Nature Cell Biology · Brandon CJ, Robinson-Thiewes S, Kaulage M 等，通訊作者 Ansari AZ（聖猶達兒童研究醫院化學生物學與治療學系，美國）· doi:10.1038/s41556-026-02044-1
tag: Friedreich's 共濟失調 · 基因去沉默
note: → 團隊設計出合成基因調控分子 SynGR1：一端結合 frataxin（FXN）基因內的重複 DNA 序列，另一端招募促轉錄蛋白 BRD4；BRD4 在抑制性的 HP1 凝聚體中形成「墊腳石」，讓 RNA 聚合酶 II 得以穿越，在抑制性甲基化標記仍存在的情況下重新啟動 FXN 表現。⚠️ 細胞層級研究，未含動物或人體資料（聖猶達 08/05 新聞稿明確載明）。記錄價值有兩層：(1) 這是共濟失調圈層出現的新模態類別——合成轉錄調控分子，值得長期追蹤；(2) 但要標明機轉界線：Friedreich's 是 GAA 重複位於非編碼區、造成 FXN 表現不足（功能喪失），而 SCA1/2/3/6/7 是 CAG 重複轉譯出毒性 polyQ 蛋白（功能獲得）——「把基因叫醒」的策略無法直接移植到 polyQ 型 SCA，兩者要解決的問題方向相反。

en.journal: Nature Cell Biology · Brandon CJ, Robinson-Thiewes S, Kaulage M et al., corresponding author Ansari AZ (Department of Chemical Biology and Therapeutics, St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, USA) · doi:10.1038/s41556-026-02044-1
en.note: → The team engineered a synthetic gene regulator, SynGR1: one end binds the repetitive DNA inside the frataxin (FXN) gene, the other recruits the transcription-activating protein BRD4, which then forms "stepping stones" inside the repressive HP1 condensates so RNA polymerase II can pass through — restoring FXN expression while the repressive methylation marks remain in place. ⚠️ Cell-based work only; no animal or human data (stated explicitly in St. Jude's 05 August release). It is recorded for two reasons: (1) it marks a new modality class appearing in the ataxia ring — synthetic transcriptional regulators — worth tracking over the long run; and (2) the mechanistic boundary must be stated: Friedreich's ataxia is a GAA repeat in a non-coding region causing insufficient FXN (loss of function), whereas SCA1/2/3/6/7 are CAG repeats translated into a toxic polyglutamine protein (gain of function) — so a strategy that wakes a silenced gene back up does not transfer directly to polyglutamine SCA; the two problems point in opposite directions.

title: When rhythm guides speech production: Insights from Parkinson's disease and spinocerebellar ataxia
journal: Cortex 204:1-21 · Fumel J, Mairano P, Ott L 等（里爾大學 CNRS UMR 9193 SCALab，法國）· doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2026.06.027
tag: SCA 構音評估 · 非藥物
note: → 比較健康對照、帕金森氏症與脊髓小腦萎縮症三組受試者在規律節律引子（rhythmic priming）下的語音表現。結果：規律節律在三組都縮短了語音起始時間，但帕金森組的獲益較小；作者推論節律引子影響的是整體時序控制，而非精細的構音層次。⚠️ 非藥物介入的認知／語言學研究，不是療法試驗，亦無疾病修飾意涵。 記錄價值：構音障礙（dysarthria）是 SCA 主要失能來源之一，也是 SARA 量表的計分項目；此類研究指出語音起始時間可能是比整體構音評分更敏感的量化指標，對日後試驗的次要終點與數位語音生物標記設計有參考價值——本社與競品的主要終點目前皆為 SARA。

en.journal: Cortex 204:1-21 · Fumel J, Mairano P, Ott L et al. (Univ. Lille, CNRS UMR 9193 SCALab, France) · doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2026.06.027
en.note: → The study compared healthy controls, people with Parkinson's disease and people with spinocerebellar ataxia on speech production under regular rhythmic priming. Regular rhythms shortened speech initiation time in all three groups, with a smaller benefit in the Parkinson's group; the authors infer that rhythmic priming acts on global timing control rather than on fine-grained articulation. ⚠️ A cognitive and linguistic study of a non-pharmacological manipulation — not a therapeutic trial, and carrying no disease-modifying implication. Why it is recorded: dysarthria is a major source of disability in SCA and a scored item on the SARA scale, and work of this kind suggests speech initiation time may be a more sensitive quantitative measure than a global articulation score — relevant to the design of secondary endpoints and digital speech biomarkers, given that SARA is the primary endpoint for Steminent and its competitors alike.

title: Enhancing the detection of HTT1a with neoepitope antibodies in mouse models of Huntington's disease
journal: Brain Communications 8(4):fcag285 · Osborne GF, Smith EJ, Sathasivam K 等，通訊作者 Landles C（倫敦大學學院，英國）
tag: polyQ 聚集偵測試劑（亨丁頓鄰域）
note: → 開發兩株新的重組新表位抗體 1B12 與 11G2，用於偵測 HTT1a——CAG 重複擴增時 HTT 前驅 mRNA 異常剪接產生的高致病性、易聚集蛋白片段。作者以一系列 knock-in（HdhQ20／Q50／Q80／Q111、CAG140、zQ175）與轉基因（YAC128、N171-82Q）小鼠，將兩株新抗體與現行標準的 MW8 抗體比較，並在 HTRF 與 MSD 兩種生物檢定平台上評估；結論建議 HTRF 用 1B12、MSD 用 11G2，以取代靈敏度受限的 MW8。⚠️ 純小鼠模型的試劑與檢定方法學論文，不含任何人體資料或療效結論。記錄價值：CAG 重複擴增造成的異常剪接是所有 polyQ 疾病共通的機轉假說（含 SCA1/2/3/6/7），而聚集體定量的靈敏度直接決定臨床前藥效判讀的解析度——Vico VO659 這類直接鎖定 CAG 重複的療法，其臨床前評估即依賴此類檢定。

en.journal: Brain Communications 8(4):fcag285 · Osborne GF, Smith EJ, Sathasivam K et al., corresponding author Landles C (University College London, UK)
en.note: → Two novel recombinant neoepitope antibodies, 1B12 and 11G2, were developed to detect HTT1a — the highly pathogenic, aggregation-prone protein produced by aberrant splicing of HTT pre-mRNA that increases as the CAG repeat expands. The authors benchmarked them against the current standard MW8 antibody across an allelic series of knock-in mice (HdhQ20/Q50/Q80/Q111, CAG140, zQ175) and transgenic YAC128 and N171-82Q models, and evaluated them on the HTRF and MSD bioassay platforms; they recommend 1B12 for HTRF and 11G2 for MSD, replacing the sensitivity-limited MW8. ⚠️ A reagent and assay-methodology paper in mouse models only — it contains no human data and no efficacy conclusions. Why it is recorded: aberrant splicing driven by CAG repeat expansion is a mechanistic hypothesis shared across the polyglutamine diseases, including SCA1/2/3/6/7, and the sensitivity of aggregate quantification sets the resolution at which preclinical pharmacodynamics can be read — assays of this kind underpin the preclinical evaluation of CAG-repeat-directed therapies such as Vico's VO659.

title: Cervical dystonia as the presenting symptom of novel calcium voltage-gated channel subunit alpha1A mutation
journal: BMJ Case Reports · Deng Y, Fletcher D, Colantonio L 等（西維吉尼亞大學醫學院，美國）
tag: CACNA1A／SCA6 圈層 · 診斷延遲
note: → 一名中年女性最初以「頸部被拉扯感」就醫，診斷為頸部肌張力不全並接受肉毒桿菌素治療；病情逐步惡化為嚴重共濟失調、吞嚥困難與構音障礙，需行動與進食協助，症狀出現十年後才經基因檢測確診為 CACNA1A 相關脊髓小腦萎縮症。作者提醒：肌張力不全可掩蓋潛在的基因性共濟失調，原因不明的肌張力不全應納入此鑑別診斷。⚠️ 單一病例報告，非系列或世代研究，不可外推盛行率。記錄價值：CACNA1A 是 SCA6／發作性共濟失調第 2 型的致病基因，也是 IntraBio N-acetyl-L-leucine 第三期試驗（NCT07221292）鎖定的族群；十年的診斷延遲直接影響此圈層試驗的可收案人數與收案時的疾病嚴重度分布。

en.journal: BMJ Case Reports · Deng Y, Fletcher D, Colantonio L et al. (WVU School of Medicine, USA)
en.note: → A middle-aged woman first presented with a pulling sensation in the neck, was diagnosed with cervical dystonia and treated with botulinum toxin. Her condition progressively worsened to severe ataxia, dysphagia and dysarthria requiring mobility and feeding assistance, and genetic testing established a diagnosis of CACNA1A-related spinocerebellar ataxia only ten years after symptom onset. The authors note that dystonia can mask an underlying genetic ataxia, and that unexplained dystonia should prompt consideration of this diagnosis. ⚠️ A single case report — not a series or cohort; prevalence cannot be inferred from it. Why it is recorded: CACNA1A is the gene behind SCA6 and episodic ataxia type 2 and defines the population targeted by IntraBio's Phase 3 trial of N-acetyl-L-leucine (NCT07221292); a ten-year diagnostic delay bears directly on the enrollable population and on the disease-severity distribution at entry for trials in this ring.

title: Establishment of four induced pluripotent stem cell lines (IGIBi028-A, IGIBi029-A, IGIBi030-A, and IGIBi031-A) from peripheral blood derived cells of Spinocerebellar ataxia Type 12 patients
journal: Stem Cell Research · Ahmad I, Reza S, Singh N 等（CSIR-IGIB／AIIMS，印度）
tag: SCA12 · iPSC 疾病模型資源
note: → 由 SCA12 病人周邊血細胞建立四株誘導性多能幹細胞（iPSC）品系，帶有 PPP2R2B 基因上游非編碼區 ≥43 個 CAG 三核苷酸重複擴增；四株均表現未分化多能性標記、具三胚層分化能力並維持基因穩定性。⚠️ 為細胞株資源論文，不含療效或機轉結論。記錄價值：SCA12 的 CAG 擴增位在非編碼區、不轉譯成多聚麩醯胺酸，機轉與 SCA1/2/3/6/7 等 polyQ 亞型不同——本社 Stemchymal 的適應症為 polyQ SCA，SCA12 不在其中。此類病人來源 iPSC 是亞型專屬藥物篩選與機轉研究的前端工具，也是觀察 SCA 領域研究能量往非 polyQ 亞型擴散的指標。

en.journal: Stem Cell Research · Ahmad I, Reza S, Singh N et al. (CSIR-IGIB / AIIMS, India)
en.note: → Four induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) lines were derived from peripheral blood cells of SCA12 patients carrying an expansion of ≥43 CAG trinucleotide repeats in the upstream non-coding region of PPP2R2B. All four expressed undifferentiated pluripotency markers, differentiated into all three germ layers and were genetically stable. ⚠️ This is a cell-line resource paper and carries no efficacy or mechanistic conclusions. Why it is recorded: the SCA12 expansion sits in a non-coding region and is not translated into a polyglutamine tract, so its mechanism differs from the polyQ subtypes SCA1/2/3/6/7 — Steminent's Stemchymal is indicated for polyglutamine SCA, which does not include SCA12. Patient-derived iPSC lines of this kind are upstream tools for subtype-specific drug screening and mechanistic work, and also mark research effort spreading into non-polyQ subtypes of SCA.

title: Long-read sequencing for neurological disorders: opportunities, challenges, and future directions
journal: Neurological Sciences · Geiger H, Furuta Y, Perera BLA 等
tag: 長讀定序 · 基因診斷綜述
note: → 綜述長讀定序（LRS）在神經疾病基因診斷的角色：短讀定序難以偵測的大型重複擴增、複雜結構變異、粒線體變異正是 LRS 的強項，文中明列脊髓小腦萎縮症與裘馨氏肌失養症、脆折 X 症候群並列為已展現效益的適應症；同時指出 DNA 品質要求、分析負荷、可近性、成本與倫理等待解限制。記錄價值：SCA 的基因型判讀（CAG 重複數、CAA 中斷、體細胞不穩定性）直接決定試驗納入條件與分層，此篇可作為診斷技術面的參考背景。⚠️ 為綜述文章、非原始資料。

en.journal: Neurological Sciences · Geiger H, Furuta Y, Perera BLA et al.
en.note: → A review of long-read sequencing (LRS) in the genetic diagnosis of neurological disease: the variant classes short-read sequencing struggles with — large repeat expansions, complex structural variants and mitochondrial variants — are precisely where LRS performs, and the paper lists spinocerebellar ataxias alongside Duchenne muscular dystrophy and fragile X syndrome as conditions where the benefit is already demonstrated. It also sets out the outstanding limits: DNA quality requirements, analytical burden, access, cost and ethical concerns. Why it is recorded: genotyping in SCA (CAG repeat length, CAA interruptions, somatic instability) directly governs trial eligibility and stratification, so this serves as background on the diagnostic technology. ⚠️ A review article, not primary data.

title: Establishing Sensory Neurons as Therapeutic Targets in Peripheral Neuropathy Driven by Polyglutamine Expanded Murine ATXN3
journal: Annals of Neurology · Mato JP, Hayes JM, Emerson J 等
tag: SCA3 周邊神經 · 治療標的
note: → SCA3 不只是小腦病變：ATXN3 敲入小鼠重現臨床可見的漸進性感覺運動缺損、周邊神經病理與神經傳導異常，而 ATXN3 敲除小鼠周邊功能正常，指向突變 ataxin-3 的毒性功能獲得而非功能喪失。研究者以 Avil-Cre 條件性敲入小鼠僅在感覺神經元中沉默突變 ATXN3，即顯著改善周邊異常與剪接失調。記錄價值：SCA3 的基因沉默療法（Vico VO659、已放棄的 Biogen/Ionis BIIB132）採鞘內給藥、標的集中在中樞；此研究指出背根神經節與周邊感覺神經元也是需要覆蓋的治療區室，對遞送途徑與療效終點是否納入周邊神經功能有設計意涵。

en.journal: Annals of Neurology · Mato JP, Hayes JM, Emerson J et al.
en.note: → SCA3 is not only a cerebellar disease: ATXN3 knock-in mice reproduced the progressive sensorimotor deficits, peripheral pathology and nerve-conduction abnormalities seen clinically, while ATXN3 knockout mice had normal peripheral function — pointing to a toxic gain of function of mutant ataxin-3 rather than loss of function. Using an Avil-Cre conditional knock-in, silencing mutant ATXN3 in sensory neurons alone significantly improved the peripheral abnormalities and splicing dysregulation. Why it is recorded: gene-silencing programmes in SCA3 (Vico's VO659, the discontinued Biogen/Ionis BIIB132) dose intrathecally and are aimed at the central compartment; this work argues that dorsal root ganglia and peripheral sensory neurons are also compartments therapy must reach, with implications for route of delivery and for whether efficacy endpoints should include peripheral nerve function.

title: Dissecting the relationship between haplotypes around ATXN2 CAG repeats and the number of CAA interruptions by long-read sequencing
journal: medRxiv（預印本）· Lee BH, Chan J, Leung YY 等
tag: SCA2／ATXN2 · 長讀定序
note: → 以 Oxford Nanopore 長讀定序同時判定 ATXN2 周邊單體型、CAG 重複數與 CAA 中斷數，並分析 41 名帶中間長度重複的神經疾病個案。三個 CAA 中斷在各族裔對照族群中盛行率僅約 1%，在帶中間長度重複的 ALS 個案中卻約 55%，且對應到由 SNV rs148019457 標記的特定單體型。⚠️ medRxiv 預印本，尚未同儕審查。記錄價值：ATXN2 是 Arrowhead／Sarepta ARO-ATXN2（SCA2 siRNA，含台北榮總站點）的標的；重複結構與中斷數影響基因型判讀，也牽動 SCA2（≥33 重複）與 ALS（27–33 重複）兩個適應症的族群界定與試驗納入條件。

en.journal: medRxiv (preprint) · Lee BH, Chan J, Leung YY et al.
en.note: → Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing was used to resolve haplotypes around ATXN2, CAG repeat number and CAA interruptions simultaneously, across 41 neurologically affected individuals carrying intermediate repeats. Three CAA interruptions were rare in controls across ancestry groups (about 1%) but common in ALS cases with intermediate repeats (about 55%), and mapped to a distinct haplotype tagged by the SNV rs148019457. ⚠️ This is a medRxiv preprint and has not been peer reviewed. Why it is recorded: ATXN2 is the target of Arrowhead/Sarepta's ARO-ATXN2 (SCA2 siRNA, with a Taipei VGH site), and repeat structure and interruption count affect genotype interpretation as well as how the SCA2 (≥33 repeats) and ALS (27–33 repeats) populations are delimited for trial eligibility.

title: Understanding Hereditary Ataxias: A Historical Quest for Definition and Classification
journal: Movement Disorders · Coutinho L, Camargo CHF, Teive HAG（巴西巴拉那聯邦大學臨床醫院神經疾病研究群）
tag: 遺傳性共濟失調 · 分類架構
note: → 回顧兩世紀來遺傳性共濟失調分類的演變：從解剖描述走向以基因為本的架構，Gordon Holmes、Joseph Greenfield 與 Anita Harding 依序形塑此領域，其中 Harding 於 1980 年代提出的遺傳模式分類法直接促成 SCA1 等致病基因的發現。作者指出現行分類在臨床上仍然受限——實質上是不斷加長的基因清單，對診斷與治療決策提供的指引有限；體染色體隱性小腦共濟失調的命名標準化雖有改善，但表型異質性與術語不一致仍未解決。記錄價值：分類混亂正是 SCA 臨床試驗難以定義同質族群的上游原因，也是跨亞型（SCA1/2/3/6）共通機轉療法在納入條件設計上相對有利的背景。

en.journal: Movement Disorders · Coutinho L, Camargo CHF, Teive HAG (Neurological Diseases Group, Hospital de Clinicas, Federal University of Parana, Brazil)
en.note: → A review of how hereditary ataxia classification has evolved over two centuries, moving from anatomical description toward genetically informed frameworks shaped in turn by Gordon Holmes, Joseph Greenfield and Anita Harding, whose inheritance-based model in the 1980s directly enabled identification of causative genes such as SCA1. The authors argue that current classifications remain clinically limited — in practice an ever-growing gene list offering little guidance for diagnostic or therapeutic decisions; standardisation for autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxias has improved clarity but phenotypic variability and inconsistent terminology remain unresolved. Why it is recorded: classification disorder is the upstream reason SCA trials struggle to define homogeneous populations, and it is the backdrop against which therapies acting on mechanisms shared across subtypes (SCA1/2/3/6) have an easier time designing eligibility criteria.

title: Polyphenol-Rich Cinnamon Bud Extract Affects Ataxin-3 Aggregation and Ameliorates SCA3 Phenotypes
journal: Molecules · Sciandrone B, Pensotti R, Ami D 等（義大利米蘭比可卡大學生物技術與生物科學系）
tag: SCA3 蛋白聚集 · 天然物
note: → 以 ataxin-3 的異常自組裝成類澱粉聚集體為標的：肉桂芽萃取物之多酚可減少富含 β-摺板的類澱粉聚集體形成，並在秀麗隱桿線蟲 SCA3 模型改善運動缺損、提升抗氧化壓力耐受。屬體外／線蟲模型階段的探索性研究，距人體試驗甚遠；記錄價值在於「抑制聚集」與本社 MSC 誘導自噬清除突變 ataxin-3 屬同一下游目標的不同路徑。

en.journal: Molecules · Sciandrone B, Pensotti R, Ami D et al. (Dept. of Biotechnology and Biosciences, University of Milano-Bicocca, Italy)
en.note: → Targets the aberrant self-assembly of ataxin-3 into amyloid aggregates: polyphenols from cinnamon bud extract reduced the formation of β-sheet-rich amyloid assemblies and, in a C. elegans SCA3 model, improved locomotor defects and increased resistance to oxidative stress. This is exploratory in-vitro and nematode-model work, far from human trials; it is recorded because aggregate suppression is the same downstream goal our MSC reaches by a different route (inducing autophagy to clear mutant ataxin-3).

title: Abnormal Local Brain Activity in SCA3 Patients with Cognitive Impairment: A Resting-State Functional MRI Study
journal: Cerebellum · Fan S, Li M, Chen X 等（中國福建醫科大學附屬第一醫院放射科）
tag: SCA3 認知 · 靜息態 fMRI
note: → 84 名 SCA3 病人與 41 名健康對照的靜息態 fMRI：合併認知障礙者在額紋狀體區 ALFF 上升、預設模式網絡 ALFF 下降，且變化與認知表現相關，涉及皮質－紋狀體－視丘－皮質迴路與小腦。SCA3 的非運動症狀評估與次要終點選擇情報——本社美國 Ph2 亦收 SCA3 族群。

en.journal: Cerebellum · Fan S, Li M, Chen X et al. (Dept. of Radiology, First Affiliated Hospital, Fujian Medical University, China)
en.note: → Resting-state fMRI in 84 SCA3 patients and 41 healthy controls: those with cognitive impairment showed increased ALFF in fronto-striatal regions and decreased ALFF in the default mode network, with the alterations correlating with cognitive performance and implicating the cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical loop and the cerebellum. Intelligence on non-motor assessment and secondary-endpoint choice in SCA3 — the population our US Ph2 is enrolling.

title: Patient-Reported Visual Function in Ataxias and Association with Clinical Oculomotor Findings
journal: Cerebellum · Yang FX, Manohar R, Luddy AC 等（美國麻省總醫院／哈佛醫學院神經科）
tag: 共濟失調 病人自述終點
note: → 56 名基因確診共濟失調病人（含 SCA3）與 61 名對照：各共濟失調族群自述視功能皆顯著差於對照，缺損最大者為視覺處理速度；凝視誘發眼震為視功能下降的獨立預測因子。與病人自述型結果測量（PRO）作為試驗終點的可用性相關。

en.journal: Cerebellum · Yang FX, Manohar R, Luddy AC et al. (Dept. of Neurology, Massachusetts General Hospital / Harvard Medical School, USA)
en.note: → In 56 people with genetically defined ataxias (including SCA3) and 61 controls, every ataxia group reported significantly worse visual function than controls, with the largest deficit in visual processing speed; gaze-evoked nystagmus independently predicted reduced visual function. Relevant to the usability of patient-reported outcome measures as trial endpoints.

title: Improving the Identification of the Preclinical Stages of Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 2
journal: Tomography · Mora-Batista C 等（墨西哥 Guerrero 自治大學／古巴 Holguín 遺傳性共濟失調研究與復健中心）
tag: SCA2 前臨床期辨識 · MRI 影像模型
note: → 針對「帶有 ATXN2 致病突變但運動症狀尚未出現」的前臨床帶因者，改用多變量方法：以多項 MRI 線性測量建立多項式邏輯迴歸，區辨健康對照（n=72）、前臨床帶因者（n=17）與已發病 SCA2（n=61），並以 SMOTE 處理前臨床組樣本不平衡。整體準確率 80.7%，AUC 分別為對照 0.96、前臨床 0.75、已發病 0.95。前臨床辨識能力仍是所有 SCA 疾病修飾療法（含細胞治療）能否往早期介入推進的關鍵瓶頸，此為方法學上的漸進改善。

en.journal: Tomography · Mora-Batista C et al. (Universidad Autónoma de Guerrero, Mexico / Centro de Investigación y Rehabilitación de las Ataxias Hereditarias, Holguín, Cuba)
en.note: → Aimed at preclinical carriers who hold the pathogenic ATXN2 mutation but have no motor manifestations yet, this study replaces univariate linear measures with a multivariate approach: a multinomial logistic regression built on multiple MRI linear measurements discriminates healthy controls (n=72), preclinical carriers (n=17) and manifest SCA2 patients (n=61), with SMOTE used to offset the small preclinical subgroup. Overall accuracy was 80.7%, with AUCs of 0.96 for controls, 0.75 for preclinical carriers and 0.95 for manifest disease. Preclinical identification remains the key bottleneck for moving any SCA disease-modifying therapy — cell therapy included — into earlier intervention; this is an incremental methodological gain.

title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Based Therapy for Cerebellar Ataxia: From Bench to Bedside
journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Suk K 等（韓國慶北大學）
tag: MSC 治療共濟失調 · 系統性回顧
note: → 直接對應本社機制的獨立回顧（文獻期間 2000–2026）：hMSC 移植在 LPS 誘發、Ara-C 誘發與 SCA2 轉基因模型皆改善運動功能、保留浦金氏細胞完整性並抑制神經發炎；關鍵觀察是共濟失調病人自體 MSC 的抗發炎分泌體能力明顯低於健康捐贈者，為異體（allogeneic）策略提供理由；SCA2 模型在症狀出現後給藥仍見療效。作者結論支持推進安慰劑對照隨機試驗。

en.tag: MSC therapy for ataxia · systematic review
en.journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Suk K et al. (Kyungpook National University, Korea)
en.note: → An independent review that maps directly onto Steminent's mechanism (literature 2000–2026): hMSC transplantation improved motor function, preserved Purkinje cell integrity and attenuated neuroinflammation across LPS-induced, Ara-C-induced and SCA2 transgenic models. A key observation is that MSCs from ataxia patients show markedly lower anti-inflammatory secretome capacity than healthy-donor MSCs, which justifies an allogeneic strategy; efficacy in the SCA2 model was maintained even when dosing began after symptom onset. The authors conclude that placebo-controlled randomised trials are warranted.

title: N140 Latency as a Novel Biomarker for the Evaluation of Somatosensory Dysfunction in Patients with Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 2
journal: Cerebellum · Gutiérrez J 等（古巴神經學與神經外科研究所）
tag: SCA2 生物標記 · 電生理
note: → 古巴 SCA2 世代（28 名病人 vs 34 名年齡配對對照）發現長潛時體感覺誘發電位 N140 潛時延長，且 N140 與 N20 潛時皆與 SARA 分數正相關；作者主張 N140 可作為 N20 之外的補充指標，反映視丘－皮質與小腦－皮質連結缺損。與試驗生物標記／次要終點選擇相關。

en.journal: Cerebellum · Gutiérrez J et al. (Cuban Institute of Neurology and Neurosurgery)
en.note: → In a Cuban SCA2 cohort (28 patients vs 34 age-matched controls), long-latency somatosensory evoked potential N140 latency was prolonged, and both N140 and N20 latencies correlated positively with SARA scores. The authors argue N140 complements N20 and reflects impaired thalamo-cortical and cerebello-cortical connectivity — relevant to biomarker and secondary-endpoint selection in trials.

title: Muscle MRI as an Imaging Biomarker of Muscle Damage in Patients With Spinal and Bulbar Muscular Atrophy
journal: Neurology · Grunseich C 等（NIH／名古屋大學／UCL／Nido Biosciences）
tag: SBMA 影像生物標記（polyQ 鄰域）
note: → 非介入縱貫研究，全身 Dixon MRI 以 AMRA Researcher 量測雙側 19 組肌肉的瘦肌肉體積、肌肉脂肪分率與脂肪浸潤，基線起每 6 個月追蹤至 18 個月，並與 SBMAFRS、2 分鐘步行測試比對靈敏度。此即 Nido Biosciences 於 NIDO-361 Ph2 採用之主要終點的方法學來源。

en.journal: Neurology · Grunseich C et al. (NIH / Nagoya University / UCL / Nido Biosciences)
en.note: → A non-interventional longitudinal study using whole-body Dixon MRI analysed with AMRA Researcher to quantify lean muscle volume, muscle fat fraction and fat infiltration across 19 bilateral muscle groups, assessed at baseline and every 6 months for up to 18 months, and correlated with SBMAFRS and the 2-minute walk test. This is the methodological source of the primary endpoint Nido Biosciences used in the NIDO-361 Ph2.

title: Beyond the brain: Polyglutamine disease pathology outside the nervous system
journal: Neurobiol Dis · Rausch JP 等（Wayne State University）
tag: polyQ 多系統病理 · 回顧
note: → 主張 polyQ 疾病（亨丁頓舞蹈症、SBMA、DRPLA 與六種 SCA）應視為具器官選擇性的全身性蛋白錯誤折疊症候群：臨床、影像、生化與屍檢資料顯示周邊器官異常常早於或伴隨神經症狀出現，並影響失能與死亡率。作者建議未來試驗設計納入縱貫、多系統表現型評估。

en.journal: Neurobiol Dis · Rausch JP et al. (Wayne State University)
en.note: → Argues that polyglutamine diseases (Huntington's disease, SBMA, DRPLA and six spinocerebellar ataxias) should be viewed as systemic protein-misfolding syndromes with organ-selective vulnerability: clinical, imaging, biochemical and post-mortem data show peripheral abnormalities that often precede or accompany neurological symptoms and contribute to disability and mortality. The authors call for longitudinal, multisystem phenotyping in future trial design.

title: Diagnostic Pitfalls in Hereditary Neurological Disorders: Machado-Joseph Disease Presenting as Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease: A Case Report
journal: Clin Case Rep · Lim ECN 等
tag: SCA3 診斷 · 案例報告
note: → Machado-Joseph 病（SCA3）以周邊神經病變（似 Charcot-Marie-Tooth）表現的診斷陷阱案例，屬 SCA3 表現型辨識與鑑別診斷情報。

en.journal: Clin Case Rep · Lim ECN et al.
en.note: → A diagnostic-pitfall case of Machado-Joseph disease (SCA3) presenting as a peripheral neuropathy (Charcot-Marie-Tooth-like); SCA3 phenotype-recognition and differential-diagnosis intelligence.

title: Comprehensive Characterization of Clinical Phenotypes and CTG Repeat-Associated Manifestations in Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 8
journal: Cerebellum · Yang D 等
tag: SCA8 表現型
note: → 系統描繪 SCA8（ATXN8OS CTG 重複）之臨床表現型與重複長度相關性，屬亞型辨識與病程分層情報。

en.journal: Cerebellum · Yang D et al.
en.note: → Systematically characterises the clinical phenotypes of SCA8 (ATXN8OS CTG repeat) and their relation to repeat length; subtype identification and disease-stratification intelligence.

title: Upstream non-AUG initiation and ribosomal -1 frameshifting in ATXN8OS CTA/CTG repeat-associated translation
journal: Nucleic Acids Res · Sakamoto S 等
tag: SCA8 機制 · RAN 轉譯
note: → 解析 ATXN8OS 重複序列的非 AUG 起始與核糖體移碼機制，屬重複擴增型 SCA 的毒性蛋白生成路徑基礎研究。

en.journal: Nucleic Acids Res · Sakamoto S et al.
en.note: → Dissects non-AUG initiation and ribosomal frameshifting at the ATXN8OS repeat; basic research on how repeat-expansion SCAs generate toxic proteins.

title: A Translational Readiness Checklist for Stem-Cell-Based Trials in Movement Disorders: A Practical Roadmap
journal: J Cent Nerv Syst Dis · Hemeda S 等
tag: 細胞治療試驗設計 · 最相關
note: → 提出幹細胞臨床試驗的「轉譯準備度查核表」（產品特性描述、基線表型調和、疾病別終點選單），並將 SCA 列為目標適應症之一——可對照本社 Ph2 試驗設計與法規論述。

en.journal: J Cent Nerv Syst Dis · Hemeda S et al.
en.note: → Proposes a translational-readiness checklist for stem-cell trials (product characterisation, harmonised baseline phenotyping, disease-specific endpoint menus) and lists SCA among the target movement disorders — a useful benchmark for our Ph2 design and regulatory narrative.

title: Cerebellar cognitive affective syndrome (CCAS) and [18F]-FDG PET findings in spinocerebellar ataxia type SCA27B
journal: J Neurol · Cros L 等
tag: SCA27B 認知 · 影像
note: → 描述 SCA27B 的小腦認知情感症候群與 FDG-PET 代謝變化，補充非運動症狀評估面向。

en.journal: J Neurol · Cros L et al.
en.note: → Describes cerebellar cognitive affective syndrome and FDG-PET metabolic changes in SCA27B, adding to the non-motor assessment picture.

title: Isoform-paralog specificity and tissue-dependent vulnerabilities in neurological disorders
journal: Genes Dev · Hernandez-Quijada K 等
tag: SCA1 機制

tag: SCA1 影像·免疫性退化對照
note: → 同一套小腦形態學比較自體免疫（anti-Yo，n=11）與遺傳性（SCA1，n=17）退化、對照 17 名健康者：免疫型呈前側小腦皮質顯著變薄，SCA1 為較輕的後側萎縮，區域特徵在機器學習下可區辨兩組。對以發炎／免疫調節為機轉的療法界定適用族群與影像終點有參考價值。

en.note: → One cerebellar morphometry framework applied to autoimmune (anti-Yo, n=11) and genetic (SCA1, n=17) degeneration against 17 healthy controls: the immune-mediated group showed pronounced anterior cortical thinning while SCA1 showed milder posterior atrophy, and regional features separated the groups under machine learning. title: How Early Should I Refer My Patient? The Benefits of a Quick Ophthalmic Referral in Spinocerebellar Ataxias, a Case Series and Literature Review
journal: Brain Sci · Fiscal-Carvajal AB 等（墨西哥新萊昂自治大學）
tag: SCA 診斷延遲·眼科線索
note: → 三例步態障礙病人最終確診 SCA2、SCA7 與 SCAR32，均歷經數年多次就診才確診；文獻回顧歸納五項可快速縮小亞型鑑別的臨床線索（巨斑病變、視神經受累、紅斑角化症、聽力損失、失智）。診斷延遲直接壓縮可收案的早期病人池，與收案速度相關。

en.journal: Brain Sci · Fiscal-Carvajal AB et al. (Universidad Autónoma de Nuevo León, Mexico)
en.note: → Three patients presenting with gait disturbance were eventually diagnosed with SCA2, SCA7 and SCAR32, all after years of repeated consultations; the accompanying review distils five clinical clues that quickly narrow the subtype differential (macular anomalies, optic nerve involvement, erythrokeratodermia, hearing loss, dementia). Diagnostic delay directly shrinks the pool of early patients available to enrol, so it bears on recruitment speed.

title: Diagnostic redirection in dementia-first spinocerebellar ataxia type 17: a family-based case report and focused literature review
journal: Front Neurosci · Zhang S 等（湖北中醫藥大學／武漢市第一醫院）
tag: SCA17 表現型譜
note: → 以失智為首發表現的 SCA17 家族案例（TBP 重複 37／51，無症狀女兒亦帶 51 重複），併 25 篇文獻回顧：發病年齡與 TBP 重複數變異大，表現橫跨認知主導、行為、亨丁頓樣、帕金森樣與癲癇型。提醒以運動症狀為主的收案條件可能系統性漏掉部分亞型病人。

en.journal: Front Neurosci · Zhang S et al. (Hubei University of Chinese Medicine / Wuhan No. 1 Hospital)
en.note: → A family case of SCA17 presenting dementia-first (TBP alleles 37/51, with an asymptomatic daughter also carrying the 51-repeat allele) plus a review of 25 studies: age at onset and TBP repeat size vary widely, and presentations span cognition-dominant, behavioural, Huntington-like, parkinsonian and seizure-associated forms. A reminder that eligibility criteria anchored on motor symptoms can systematically miss part of the subtype population.
